name: id_string_echo_errorpath
description: Fable r1 counterexample, as a regression: 200 successes echo the numeric request id exactly, but HTTP 500 error bodies echo it as a JSON string. The error path must enforce the id echo exactly like the 200 path (C1): protocol.id-echo fails, no error code behind the broken echo is interpreted, and every *.recognized / error-path row is availability unknown (never method evidence)
